final: WITH c AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS n FROM account a LEFT JOIN `order` o ON o.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id), tot AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS t FROM c), s AS (SELECT c.account_id, c.n, CAST(c.n AS REAL) / tot.t AS share FROM c, tot), av AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.n) AS total_orders, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - av.a) AS avg_excess FROM s, av WHERE s.share > av.a
